system.notes: With this sorcerous arcana activated, a Zoran can more easily discern truth from lies. By paying attention to any speaker within range, the Zoran can attempt to tell if the speaker’s words are true, receiving a +10 bonus to their PER + Deduce Motive roll. If the speaker willingly utters what they know to be a falsehood, the sorcerer sheds tears of blood, revealing the lie to all who are nearby.
